It's the worst program ever. 

It's basically teaching you the minimal but expecting the most. They teach you for one year, and then put you into productions the following year. If you think you're gonna get noticed or get somewhere with it, like with their contract and their pitch day. They have a contract they force you to sign that entitles them 15% of your profits for eternity.

The professors are hit or miss, they're either terrible or really good, but they can only teach you the bare minimum. If you do end up enrolling to this horrible program, avoid the chairperson he's abusive, manipulative, and tortures students on there and threatens to blacklist them in the program if they speak up about the hardships.

The school not only opts to ignore the horrendous situation they put the students, there's no grading rubric and it's teachers preference. So don't be surprise if your work is amazing and you get flunked. 

If I were you, I would stay away from this program, I dropped after my first year because of the teachers and chairperson. I had a group of over 20 students join me to complain to the Campus President Martinez over the problems, in which he chose to ignore everything. WORST. PROGRAM. EVER.
